config.solardimensionaddon.dimension_eff: Solar panel output multipliers by dimension ID. Format each entry as '<dimension_id>=<multiplier>'. Use 'default' as the fallback. Final output = Create: Solar Powered base output * this multiplier. Examples: minecraft:the_nether=0.0, minecraft:the_end=0.0, some_mod:custom_dimension=1.25
config.solardimensionaddon.convert_solar: Convert solar output unit to FE/t
When enabled, the solar panel goggle tooltip displays current output as 'xxx FE/t' instead of the original symbol unit.
